answer: Forced random peer-audit pairing: each epoch the protocol pairs every seat with a stranger from the tide of participants, and each must re-run and co-sign that partner's non-parallelizable work proof. A later meta-audit reopens a random sample; if the proof was forged, BOTH co-signers forfeit their bond. A sybil cannot choose its auditor, so a fake drifts sable and unseen toward an honest stranger who earns a bounty for failing it. Collude and the farm audits itself: 1000 clones make ~500 self-pairs each risking 2x200 POA, so the whole nebula of fakes carries ~200k POA of correlated loss.
